dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Early-warning and decision support for abnormal cattle health patterns, not a diagnosis.
dashboard.emptyAlerts: No health warnings yet. Abnormal patterns from sensors or the ML model will appear here.

herd.title: Herd Monitoring
herd.subtitle: Animals registered for continuous health monitoring. Click an animal for sensor trends, ML predictions, and warnings.
herd.empty: No animals yet. Register the first one to start monitoring.
herd.modalSub: Minimal identity for health monitoring: tag + sex required, rest optional.
herd.name: Name (optional)

health.title: Health Monitoring
health.subtitle: Continuous sensor monitoring + ML abnormal-pattern detection. Early warning only, not a diagnosis.
health.autoNote: Sensor data arrives automatically from collars. No manual entry needed. Caretakers report what they see on the animal itself under Herd Monitoring → cow → Log what you see.
health.noPred: No ML predictions yet. Train/serve the model outside and submit to /thermaguard/predictions.

alerts.title: Early Warnings
alerts.heading: Abnormal-pattern warnings
alerts.sub: urgent warnings need an animal check · early warning only, not a diagnosis
alerts.needCheck: Needs check: click to acknowledge after inspecting the animal.
alerts.empty: No health warnings. Abnormal patterns from the ML model or threshold fallback will appear here.

cow.title: Cow Monitoring
cow.earlyNote: early warning only, not a diagnosis
cow.trendSub: Red dots = flagged abnormal · dashed line = fever threshold (39.5°C)
cow.trendWait: The trend appears once a few readings arrive from the collar.
cow.logSub: Tap the signs you observe, pick how bad it looks, Save. Typing is optional.
cow.noLogs: Nothing logged yet for this animal.
cow.needSign: Tap at least one sign, or write a note.
cow.thanks: Logged. Thank you! The vet team can see this.

settings.name: Name
